title: Nexus-Util
description: This mod features four new features into Minecraft that changes how the game works in many ways like leaving bread crumb trails for cave exploration, pinging feature for multiplayer, scanning feature that makes the player aware of the surroundings, glyphs
body:
**Nexus is a lightweight, high-performance utility mod designed to bridge the gap between navigation, combat awareness, and team communication. Whether you are playing solo or on a large multiplayer server, Nexus provides the tools you need to stay in control.**

# Key Features -

## Visual Breadcrumb Trails
Never lose your way again. Press N to Automatically leave a dynamic trail of markers as you explore, allowing you to backtrack through caves, dungeons, or vast landscapes with ease. Each trail is of different color for every player.

![Breadcrumb Trails](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07f2eddea4816eb41be944f197591912c6e21d79_0.webp)

## Tactical Ping System
Coordinate with your team instantly. Use the ping system to highlight points of interest by pressing the V key, treasure, or danger, ensuring every player on your server is on the same page.

![Pinging Mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b85b49bad183360e38ff2ecab0c36cdf918dfc66.png)

## Survival Sense
The Sense feature allows you to actively scan your surroundings to temporarily highlight nearby mobs by pressing the R key, it can also scan ores, loot, giving you and the other player the upper hand.

![Survival Sense detecting mobs and ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec22c413048e70af6c77b96aaaa893a0cdf47847.png)

## Action Glyph System
Nexus utilizes a unique glyph overlay system to display your current actions or states, perfect for roleplay servers and team communication. It has a glyph for actions like player smelting something, player opening chat, player opening crafting table, player enchanting something, player using other items like smithing table.

![Action glyphs indicating player action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/170417ca9eb5131446878db8b6208142d5f37052.png)

## Server-Side Synchronization
Engineered for multiplayer. All features—from pings to breadcrumbs—are built to sync perfectly across the network, ensuring that what you see is what your teammates see.
